1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, and __a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes and comprising a phosphor material__.

2. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body__.

7. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section __and wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body and one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body__.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 7 wherein __a single diode resides on each face and a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode__.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK __and wherein said columnar body has an elongated hollow polygonal structure with substantially straight side walls and a general A19 outline__.

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base __or a wedge base and closes a first end of said columnar body__.

14. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and is disposed within said columnar body in electrical communication with said base member and said light emitting diodes__.

15. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __by positioning said light emitting diodes and said optic element in cooperative geometric relationship__.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 100 W/mK with a plurality of integral radially extending fins, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching a single light emitting diode to each side of said body, __attaching a light dispersing optic element comprising a phosphor material overlapping each diode__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diodes.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about 150 W/mK __and wherein said body has substantially straight side walls__.
